contea di ritrovamento: North East Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [-]STAN S PF AVG ; R/ [VICTORIAE] DD AVGGQ NN

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Constans (333-350), Two Victories issue of 347-348, Trier mint, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust draped and rosette diademed right, large eye. Obverse inscription: [-]STAN S PF AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories standing facing each other holding wreaths, leaf shape between figures. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE] DD AVGGQ NN. In exergue: TRP. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 15.7mm, Weight: 1.12gms, die axis: 6
